SELECT Template_Type_Code
FROM (
    SELECT t.Template_Type_Code, COUNT(*) AS doc_count
    FROM Documents d
    JOIN Templates t ON d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID
    GROUP BY t.Template_Type_Code
    ORDER BY doc_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS sub;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT Template_Type_Code
FROM (
    SELECT t.Template_Type_Code, COUNT(*) AS doc_count
    FROM Documents d
    JOIN Templates t ON d.Template_ID = t.Template_ID
    GROUP BY t.Template_Type_Code
    ORDER BY doc_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS sub;
